newWebPolicies.context: Leaving route, hidden tab, explicit release, save and restore stop pending callback and invalidate current sky. Only one fixed telescope/calibration exists, so no unsupported telescope is synthesized.
newWebPolicies.timer: One100ms callback per start; no wall-time catchup or partial callback counts. Generation guard excludes stale completion.
newWebPolicies.notebook: User-supplied finite V transcription[-50,100] and note<=500chars, linked to completed object reading. No catalog answer/auto grade or native Record equivalence.
newWebPolicies.persistence: Separate OpenCLEA Pleiades photometer session v1; seed plus strict events only,128KiB/256events, fieldSHA pinned, replay counts/reduction, released context required. Existing full analysis v7 unchanged and not accepted as this format.
newWebPolicies.boundary: Bounded pointings/telescope0/V/explicit1arcmin/profile only. General telescope/filters, native report compatibility, generated cluster and whole-I01/E04 not claimed.
